messages:
Lena Ortiz: Hi team, Lena here, joining Infra today. Quick access/TLS question for my first-day tasks: I need a dev GCP project in europe-west1 and AWS access to the APAC dev account (assume role).

Lena Ortiz: Specifically: create project `redwood-lena-dev` or grant me permissions to create projects under the dev folder. GCP roles I'd need: roles/editor for initial setup, roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin to create service accounts, and roles/storage.admin for bucket ops. Also want to restrict to europe-west1.

Lena Ortiz: On AWS: need ability to assume `arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-APAC` and put objects to `s3://redwood-dev-artifacts/lena/*` for CI artifacts. Who should I ping for billing link to EU billing and cost center mapping?

Infra Onboarding Bot: Created ticket ONB-7987 for Lena Ortiz. Please confirm the cost center and whether you need a long-lived SA or a short-lived key for CI.

Max Liu: welcome Lena! :tada: For billing, ping Finance Bot with cost center code. We usually prefer short-lived SA keys and Workload Identity where possible. If you really need a key for CI, mark it as ephemeral and add rotation notes.

Eve Robinson: hi Lena, I can handle the GCP bits. If you want project creation rights we need an approval from Platform Eng lead + cost center. Otherwise we create the project and grant the roles. Which do you prefer?

Lena Ortiz: prefer that infra creates the project and links billing, less risky. Cost center: COST-INFRA-ENG-DEV. No PO for now. CI will use ephemeral SA, we'll wire Workload Identity for GKE later.

Max Liu: ack. For AWS assume-role, confirm you have your MFA device set up in Okta/SSO. If you need the CLI command:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn "arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-APAC" --role-session-name lena-session
# then export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY from the output
```

Eve Robinson: noted. We'll provision `redwood-lena-dev` under the dev folder, grant roles/editor + iam.serviceAccountAdmin + storage.admin scoped to project, and link to billing id BILL-EU-09A1 with cost center COST-INFRA-ENG-DEV.

Eve Robinson: Question for infra: do we want to create a short-lived SA for Lena now or wait until she has the project? If short-lived, we create a key with 24h expiry and document rotation in the ticket.

Finance Bot: Finance approval required for billing link. Please include cost center and estimated monthly spend. Reply here to approve.

Lena Ortiz: estimated spend: minimal for dev (<$100/mo) during onboarding. Approve linking to BILL-EU-09A1 / COST-INFRA-ENG-DEV.

Finance Bot: Approved by finance for BILL-EU-09A1, note in ONB-7987.

Infra Onboarding Bot: ONB-7987 updated: provisioning project and GCP roles. Expected completion: 8 hours. AWS assume-role trust policy update queued; Max will confirm when done.

Cloud Platform: Done: created project `redwood-lena-dev` (ID: redwood-lena-dev-2026) and linked billing BILL-EU-09A1. Granted roles/editor, roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin, roles/storage.admin to lena.ortiz@redwood.ai.

Cloud Platform: Created ephemeral service account `ci-lena-ephemeral@redwood-lena-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with 24h key. Key delivered via secure ticket link in ONB-7987. AWS trust policy updated to allow sts:AssumeRole from SAML principal for your Okta identity. Max, can you confirm the S3 prefix perms?

Max Liu: Confirmed - granted s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket for prefix `redwood-dev-artifacts/lena/`. Lena, try a small put: 

```
aws s3 cp test.txt s3://redwood-dev-artifacts/lena/test.txt --profile assumed-lena
```

Lena Ortiz: tested both GCP and AWS flows, everything works. Thanks everyone! I'll close the loop in ONB-7987 after CI integration tests. :raised_hands:
